endpoint_policy: An operator binds an already provisioned endpoint to a pinned model identity. Registry entries never download weights or allocate compute.
comparison_policy: Use the same text JSON action protocol and task budget. Record the provider template, inference precision, recurrence and all generated tokens. Report model variants separately.

models.template: Frozen training serialization, without a chat template. For a GGUF export use completion mode and separately record its hash.
models.availability: Native export is recorded on the operator's Google Drive. The named private Hugging Face repository was empty in the repository receipt.

models.template: Pinned repository chat template, with enable_thinking explicitly recorded. vLLM tool parsing requires qwen3_coder and reasoning parsing requires nemotron_v3 when native tools are used.

models.parameter_label_note: The 3B model name refers to non-embedding parameters. The full checkpoint contains 4,169,800,704 parameters.
models.template: Pinned tokenizer template; record enable_thinking and preserve_thinking explicitly. Upstream recommends preserve_thinking for agent work and requires model-specific code for its architecture.
Pinned tokenizer chat template. Set enable_thinking explicitly, count reasoning tokens against the generation budget and report thinking-mode variants separately.

Use <|im_start|><|quad_end|><|object_ref_end|>{prompt}<|im_end|> for the synth,cot condition, or <|object_ref_start|> for direct. Prefill token_type_ids must be 1 for every prompt position. Record the selected condition.
models.required_adapter: A PrefixLM-aware serving adapter that preserves bidirectional prompt attention and performs no implicit chat templating; the common JSON action protocol is rendered inside the condition envelope.

models.display_name: Inky Mini research counterpart, TML d24 variable loop, three passes
models.parameter_label_note: The model card reports 26.4B total and 3.4B active at one pass, adding about 1.0B effective active parameters per extra pass. This variable-loop research counterpart has a distinct identity from fixed-loop Inkling 2 Mini.
models.template: Pinned repository tokenizer and text-only input. Record pass count and serving implementation. No official hosted API is promised by the model release.
models.required_adapter: Operator-provided serving implementation for Inkling2LoopForConditionalGeneration with the native mixed-precision checkpoint.

future_checkpoint_contract.revision_rule: Use an immutable source revision where hosted, and the SHA-256 of the exact evaluated weights or export. A name or moving branch is insufficient.
future_checkpoint_contract.variant_rule: Different weight export, quantization, recurrence, template or thinking mode receives its own run identity. Preserve the native 999,352,320-parameter count for the tied Baby Goblin model, while recording expanded export storage separately.
